tool_schemas.name: search_movies
tool_schemas.description: Searches TMDB for movies and returns the TMDB search results payload, recording the call, consulting/refreshing the cache, and incrementing API key usage counters; results are paged using TMDB’s own pagination fields (e.g., page/total_pages/total_results) when present. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the key has exceeded its allowed usage, and VALIDATION_ERROR if required search inputs are missing or malformed. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when TMDB cannot be reached or returns a non-success response.

tool_schemas.name: get_recommendations
tool_schemas.description: Returns TMDB recommendations for a given movie ID, logging the request, serving from cache when available, and updating API key usage counters; any list results follow TMDB’s pagination fields when included in the upstream payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the movie ID is missing or not a valid identifier, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the API key has hit its limit. Raises NOT_FOUND when TMDB indicates the movie does not exist, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for TMDB/network failures or unexpected upstream responses.

tool_schemas.name: get_trending
tool_schemas.description: Returns TMDB trending movies for the requested time window, recording the inbound call, caching the upstream response for performance, and updating per–API key usage counters; trending results follow TMDB’s pagination fields (e.g., page/total_pages) when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the time window is missing or not one of the supported values, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if usage limits are exceeded. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when TMDB is unavailable, times out, or returns an error response.

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded tool invocations (search_movies/get_recommendations/get_trending), newest-first, with optional filtering by API key, tool name, status, and time range; refuses invalid filters and may reject unauthorized access.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication/authorization; required for all non-public operations.

api_key_id.description: Filter results to a specific api_keys.id.

started_from.description: Return requests with started_at >= this timestamp (UTC).

started_to.description: Return requests with started_at <= this timestamp (UTC).

tool_schemas.name: get_tool_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tool request by id, including status, error details (when failed), cache mode, and response linkage; refuses if the caller is unauthorized or the id is not found.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication/authorization.

tool_schemas.name: list_tmdb_responses
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached TMDB response entries with optional filtering by tool name, cache key, status, and freshness window; returns metadata and may omit large payloads unless explicitly requested.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication/authorization.

cache_key.description: Filter by exact deterministic cache key.

fetched_from.description: Return entries with fetched_at >= this timestamp (UTC).

fetched_to.description: Return entries with fetched_at <= this timestamp (UTC).

include_response_json.description: When true, include response_json in each row (may be large).

tool_schemas.name: update_tmdb_response_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a cached response lifecycle state (fresh↔stale or fresh/stale→purged) to support cache invalidation and retention policies; refuses invalid transitions or attempts to modify purged entries.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication/authorization.

status.description: Target lifecycle status; transitions allowed: fresh→stale|purged, stale→fresh|purged.

null_out_request_links.description: When purging, if true the service may set tool_requests.response_id to NULL where required to preserve integrity while removing payload access.

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key record with quotas and initial active/suspended status; returns the created key metadata and the only time the raw API key may be shown. Refuses invalid quota values or attempts to create keys without authorization.

admin_api_key.description: Privileged API key credential required to manage api_keys.

label.description: Human-readable label for the key (e.g., app name).

quota_requests_per_day.description: Daily request quota for this key.

quota_requests_per_minute.description: Per-minute request quota for this key.

status.description: Initial status; revoked is not allowed at creation.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated identity for the presented API key, including key status, effective scopes, and current quota consumption for minute/day buckets; refuses if the API key is missing, invalid, suspended, or revoked.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication.

metadata.name: TMDB Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a TMDB proxy/search service that records inbound tool calls (search, trending, recommendations), caches TMDB movie metadata and response payloads for performance, and enforces API key usage limits. Main workflows are: client calls a tool -> request is logged -> cache is consulted
